title: Verification proof: audit an AI-built app and fix what it got wrong
purpose: With the owner's permission, audit a real AI-built app for the mistakes AI makes and fix the critical ones.
why: Anyone can generate an app now; catching what the AI got wrong is the scarce skill. AI-written code still fails security checks about half the time (Veracode, July 2026), and this year's breaches of AI-built apps came from access rules, inverted login logic and exposed keys. A dated audit with fixes shows exactly the judgment teams are hiring for.
evidence: Audit report URL, shared with the owner's OK.

tasks.title: Get the owner's written OK to audit their app and share the report
tasks.done_when: The owner said yes in writing, and you saved it.

tasks.title: Run the audit: access rules on every table, login logic, exposed keys, input handling, deploy and rollback
tasks.done_when: Every item on the checklist is marked pass, fail or not applicable, with where you looked.

tasks.title: Fix the critical findings and show each one before and after
tasks.done_when: Each critical finding has a fix the owner merged or accepted, and a check that proves it.

tasks.title: Write the one-page report: what was wrong, the risk, the fix, how you verified it
tasks.done_when: A stranger can read it in 3 minutes and check one fix themselves.

tasks.title: Explain one finding out loud in 3 minutes, recorded
tasks.done_when: A recording you'd send a hiring manager.
